name: hotels
notes: A search folder, not a rendering folder: it has no sample and strips nothing. It exists so the second search pass asks the hotel chains directly, because a hotel confirmation often has a subject line the generic pass one terms never match, and so that mail from one of these senders is detected as a hotel rather than falling through to the plaintext catch all. The subject patterns are deliberately narrow, so a stay confirmation that arrives as a text body from a domain not listed here still reaches the plaintext rules and renders as a monospace block. A chain that needs real cleaning gets its own folder with its own sample, the way marriott does. Timing and reading: a folio follows checkout by a day or two, so this folder pads its second pass by two days, and it names no tender, line or gap of its own because it has no sample to read them from.
